newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A large cosignement of gold bullion, believed to be worth one million dirhams and reportedly smuggled by a Dubai trader, was seized by Indian customs.
- Emirates Bank International halts purchases in new equity fund by expatriates.
- State-owned Kuwait Petroleum Corporation is pressing ahead with plans to expand its overseas refining capacity with a focus on Asian markets.
- President Sheikh Zaid discusses the Middle East peace process with Jordan's prime minister.
- Newly-formed Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank to announce on Thursday results of subscription.
